heading: Pilot program on small government flexibility

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Director of the Office of Management and Budget, in consultation with Federal agencies, shall establish pilot programs in at least 2 agencies to test innovative, and more flexible regulatory approaches that—

children.text: reduce reporting and compliance burdens on small governments; and
meet overall statutory goals and objectives.

tree.heading: Program focus
tree.text: The pilot programs shall focus on rules in effect or proposed rules, or a combination thereof.
